As the Amazon early Black Friday sale rolls on and Walmart launches its giant event, we are still tracking the 2026 AirTag 2 Mac to its lowest price ever at $17.50 each, rare deals on Magic Mouse and Magic Trackpad, $250 price drops on M5 MacBook Air, and even more. Amazon’s HomeView pre-order discount is still live with shipping as soon as Monday (here’s our hands-on review), and we are now tracking a rare $300 off this M5 iPad Pro model as well as this deal on Apple’s iPad Magic Keyboard Case today. From there we move onto a collection of early Black Friday deals on official Apple Watch bands from $32 and the ongoing ongoing AirPods Pro 3 deal at $50 off. Everything else awaits below.

AirPods Pro 3 $50 off, AirPods Max 2 $100 off in early Black Friday sales launching today

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (Reg. $549)

Latest AirTag 2 drops back to best price ever at $17.50 each today in early Black Friday sale

AirTag 2 just dropped back to its best price ever at just $17.50 each. The Amazon early Apple Black Friday deals are live, with a major $250 price drop on M5 MacBook Air, Apple Watch Ultra 4 at nearly $100 off, and AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off, but it is now also offering all-time low pricing on Apple’s latest 2026 AirTag 2 – the single is still down at $23 but the 4-pack has now dropped to $69.99 shipped.

Amazon has been offering the single AirTag 2 listing down at $23 since late October, and that is the lowest we have tracked there for one of them, but the 4-pack is a much better per-AirTag price and it is now listed at $69.99 shipped.

  • 1-pack AirTag 2 $23 (Reg. $29) – Matching all-time low
  • 4-pack AirTag 2 $70 (Reg. $99) – Matching all-time low

Amazon’s Apple HomeView pre-order deal is live and delivering as soon as Monday

The early Amazon Black Friday sale is now live and, while we are not expecting much in the way of major cash discounts on Apple’s new HomeView this month, it is now offering it at a discount with delivery as soon as Monday at this point.

The new Apple HomeView is officially set for release tomorrow, but unless you already pre-ordered one from somewhere chances are your deliver will be delayed (if it isn’t already).

Amazon’s listing for the new Apple home display is now listed as arriving as early as Monday, November 16 – just three days after release and one of the better deliver windows we have seen in a while now.

It also happens to still be offering a slight pre-order discount on the Space Gray model at $289.99 – not a huge deal, but it is less than Apple.

As of right now, Apple is listing HomeView as delivering somewhere between November 30 and December 7.

While delivery windows change depending on where you are and when you purchase, as of right now it looks like many folks are paying less and getting them sooner from Amazon.

Best deal in months hits M5 iPad Pro at nearly $300 off

It has been quite an long time since we have seen Apple’s best iPad with a deep discount. But today at Amazon you’ll find the 1TB M5 iPad Pro at nearly $300 off the list – this is the best price we have tracked on Amazon in approaching 5 months.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s 11-inch M5 iPad Pro with the 1TB storage capacity down at $1,499.99 shipped. This deal is live on both the Space Black and Silver models.

Regularly $1,799, this is just shy of $300 off the list and the lowest price we have tracked since early July.

The iPad Pro, much like the rest of the Mac and iPad lineups, received some price increases back in late June and deals have largely been somewhere between as good as it gets and not good at all since then.

Today, however, we are getting what, all things considered, is one of the best discounts we have tracked in months for folks looking to side step the impressive $250 price drops on MacBook Air and the new MacBook Pro releases for a slick all-iPad setup.

There are some $100 and $150 price drops on other models in the lineup right now, some for less than the deal above, but this 1TB is clearly the best of the bunch.
